spec.command: bash -c "cd /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie && export WANDB_DISABLED=true && export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 && echo '=== Step 1: LoRA Training ===' && python scripts/train_lora_wikievents.py 2>&1 | tee /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/p1_ee_ft_train.log && echo '=== Step 2: Unconstrained Inference ===' && python run_constrained_extraction.py --dataset wikievents --mode unconstrained --model_path checkpoints/qwen3_8b_lora_wikievents_merged --data_path data/wikievents/test.jsonl --output_path outputs/ee_qwen_ft_wikievents_unconstrained.jsonl --device cuda:0 2>&1 | tee /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/p1_ee_ft_unc_infer.log && echo '=== Step 3: Constrained Inference ===' && python run_constrained_extraction.py --dataset wikievents --mode full_s1 --model_path checkpoints/qwen3_8b_lora_wikievents_merged --data_path data/wikievents/test.jsonl --output_path outputs/ee_qwen_ft_wikievents_full_s1.jsonl --device cuda:0 2>&1 | tee /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/p1_ee_ft_con_infer.log && echo '=== Step 4: Evaluation ===' && python eval_event_extraction.py --input_path outputs/ee_qwen_ft_wikievents_unconstrained.jsonl 2>&1 | tee /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/p1_ee_ft_eval_unc.log && python eval_event_extraction.py --input_path outputs/ee_qwen_ft_wikievents_full_s1.jsonl 2>&1 | tee /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/p1_ee_ft_eval_con.log && echo '=== Step 5: Violation Check ===' && python violation_checker_wikievents.py --input_path outputs/ee_qwen_ft_wikievents_unconstrained.jsonl --constraints_path data/wikievents/ontology_constraints_wikievents.json 2>&1 | tee /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/p1_ee_ft_viol_unc.log && python violation_checker_wikievents.py --input_path outputs/ee_qwen_ft_wikievents_full_s1.jsonl --constraints_path data/wikievents/ontology_constraints_wikievents.json 2>&1 | tee /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/p1_ee_ft_viol_con.log && echo '=== ALL DONE ===' | tee /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/p1_ee_ft_COMPLETE"

experiment_data.hypothesis: LoRA fine-tuning Qwen3-8B on WikiEvents EE with correct train/dev/test splits (no data leakage) will produce a model whose unconstrained output has schema violations that are reduced by constrained decoding (full_s1), demonstrating composability of schema constraints with fine-tuned models.
